books.confound_note: orthography_normalised maps -- and spaced hyphens to an em dash and straightens quotes, on BOTH sides. It is POST-HOC: added after RULE-21 returned 51x in books and inf in dialogue, which turned out to be a character-encoding difference rather than a writing habit. Where a rule appears below, the as_registered figure is measuring a font.

confounds.name: paired em-dash aside in one sentence

rows.name: N of us / N of them
it is not X. it is Y.
X does not Y; Y does
that is what / that is why / that is all
the question that matters / what matters
paired em-dash aside in one sentence
so far as / as far as I can tell
I record / I set down / I note
the kind of / the sort of
there is no / there was no
it is not a joke / not a figure of speech
